title: Nearly balanced spanning subdivisions in dense digraphs
summary: Pavez-Signé [Combin. Probab. Comput. 33 (2024), 121--128] conjectured a Dirac-type condition for spanning $H$-subdivisions and asked whether the subdivision paths can additionally be required to have similar lengths. Lee [European J. Combin. 124 (2025), 104059] resolved the existence conjecture in the stronger setting of digraphs.
